dist/reading-comfort.js.scope: Runtime-only reading aids on article pages: remaining-time hint estimated from visible prose (code and folded material excluded), a progress bar on the sticky toolbar, and a per-browser offer to resume the last section when a chapter is reopened without a fragment. Static article HTML, anchors and outlines are unchanged.

dist/reading-comfort.css.scope: Styles for the progress bar, remaining-time hint and resume notice.

README.md.scope: Documents the reading aids and the optional real-browser reader verifier.

dist/static-reading-version.js.scope: Regenerated by render-pages after the reviewed source changes.

dist/reader-runtime-manifest.json.scope: Regenerated by render-pages after the reviewed source changes.

review_scope.feature: Article reading aids: remaining time, progress bar and resume offer
review_scope.verification: scripts/verify-reader-comfort.py passed on Chrome desktop and WebKit iPhone for three chapters; all 78 chapters load without page errors with estimates between 6 and 32 minutes (median 15).
review_scope.not_verified: Reading-time estimates are heuristics, not measured reader times; no reader trials.
